newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Svedala buys France's crushing co CFBK.
newsitem.headline: Svedala buys France's crushing co CFBK.

text.p: Swedish industrial group Svedala Industri said on Monday it has acquired French crushing and sorting equipment company Compagnie Francaise BK (CFBK) from private French investors.

"The acquisition of CFBK together with the acquisition of Dragon, announced earlier this year, make Svedala the market leader on crushing and sorting equipment in France," the company said in a statement.
After the acquisition, Svedala's French units will have a turnover of about one billion crowns.
CFBK's turnover amounts to more than 200 million crowns and it has 170 employees, Svedala said. The company's head office is in Paris and its workshops in Chauny, north of Paris.
"The acquisitions in France are part of the Svedala group's aim to strengthen its market position in southern Europe," said Sven Ek, Svedala Industri's vice president.
CFBK is one of France's leading deliverers to the stone industry and has a strong position in the French speaking countries in north Africa and the Middle East.
Svedala did not release further financial details.
